Our Mission

Example School nurtures curious, courageous, and compassionate learners who act with integrity and serve their communities. We believe that character and scholarship grow together, and that every student deserves to be known, challenged, and supported.

Our Values

Curiosity drives our classrooms: students ask hard questions and pursue answers across disciplines. Integrity guides our conduct: we do the right thing even when no one is watching. Community anchors our culture: students, faculty, and families share responsibility for one another and for the world beyond our campus.

The Family Handbook

This handbook describes the expectations, routines, and traditions that shape daily life at the school. Families should review it together at the start of each academic year.
